summary: WelcomeStudentPRHistory is a web user control for displaying a student's Placement Record (PR) History. It retrieves and organizes confirmed and unconfirmed placements and provides sorting, data binding, and reporting functionalities for student placement records.
purpose: To display and manage a student’s Placement Record (PR) history including confirmed, unconfirmed/future placements, provide sorting and reporting features, and facilitate interactive workflow for site supervisors and students within the HSPnet system.

workflows.name: Display PR History
steps: On DataBind, retrieve student's PR history using PRSearchStudents.StudentSearchPRHistory.
Separate PR records into confirmed (ConfLst), unconfirmed/future (NotConfLst) based on status and placement conditions.
Bind confirmed list to rprPRStudHistory repeater.
Bind unconfirmed/future list to rprFuture repeater.
If lists are empty, panels are hidden accordingly.

workflows.name: Sorting PR Records
steps: User interacts with repeater header (e.g., cmdStart, cmdCourse, cmdStatus, etc.).
Set corresponding sort expression and direction using ViewState.
Sort the lists (ConfLst or NotConfLst) by field and direction.
Re-bind sorted data to the repeater.

workflows.name: Print PR History Report
steps: Call HSPnet.Framework.Reporting.RunReport with student session and PR history parameters.
Display generated report HTML in lblReportHTML and make pnlReportHTML visible.

business_rules: Confirmed PR history includes placements with StatusCode == 'Conf' or ReleasedToTempAssignedStudent.
Future placements shown if StatusCode is null and the placement end date is on or after today.
If WithHoldPlacement is true, confirmed placements are shown in unconfirmed/future section for students.
validations: Only show entries ending on or after today's date in future section.
Validate sorting expressions and directions for both confirmed and unconfirmed repeater lists.
calculations: PREndDate is determined by checking if EndDateBlock2 is null; if so, use EndDate, otherwise use EndDateBlock2.
conditions: If UserSession is not null, proceed with PR history retrieval and binding.
If ConfLst.Count > 0, show and bind confirmed placements.
If NotConfLst.Count > 0, show and bind future/unconfirmed placements, otherwise hide.
system_behavior: Panels (pnlFuture, pnlReportHTML) are dynamically shown or hidden based on data availability.
Sorting direction toggles between ASC and DESC using ViewState when interacted.
Repeater items are styled as alternating rows for visual clarity.
Supervisor caption is dynamically displayed in header rows.
dependencies: Repeater controls for listing and interaction.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, PR history is not retrieved or displayed.
If sorting expressions are invalid or missing, default sorting is applied.
content_gaps: No detailed business rules about permissions, error handling, or user feedback for edge cases.
Details on PRSearchStudents class structure or methods are not present.
No UI layout or .ascx designer markup provided.
